purpose: Computes the SCRA 6% interest rate cap per 50 USC §3937 for pre-service loan obligations. Calculates covered months, excess interest, and forgiveness amount. Excess interest is always forgiven (not deferred) per 50 USC §3937(a)(2). Checks servicemember notification requirement. Flags SCRA_RATE_CAP_VIOLATION (original rate > 6%) and SCRA_NOTIFICATION_MISSING. Table: SCRA-50USC3937-2022.
